Description: ATMs are ubiquitous magic machines that must communicate even to the most remote locations. To make that happen ATM manufacturers have implemented a wide variety of proprietary protocols and communications over the past 50 years--often relying on dial-up and cellular modems. This hands-on experience explores those systems and the supporting protocols by taking you from ATM acquisition to analysis to simulating free cash money with minimal expenses in tools. This session is a must see for security professionals, manufacturers, and anyone trying to secure a publicly available high value target.
